entities.summary: Toontje Van Lankvelt  is a former Canadian male volleyball player. He was part of the Canada men's national volleyball team at the 2014 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Poland. He last played for Hyundai Capital in Korea, but has played for a variety of other European teams throughout his professional career.
